entities.definition: A technique to inject token order information into sequence models lacking recurrence or convolutions by adding sinusoidal or learned vectors to input embeddings.
keyClaims: Injected into input embeddings to supply sequence order
Uses sinusoidal functions with varying frequencies or learned embeddings
Compensates for permutation invariance of pure attention

entities.definition: Linear transformations that project input embeddings into Query, Key, and Value vector representations.
keyClaims: Queries represent search targets of the current token
Keys represent content identifiers matched against queries
Values carry the semantic content to be aggregated

entities.definition: An exponential normalization function converting raw logits into a valid probability distribution where weights sum to 1.
keyClaims: Divides dot products by square root of key dimension to prevent gradient saturation
Converts attention logits into a non-negative probability distribution summing to 1

entities.definition: An attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence to compute a contextualized representation as a weighted sum of Values.
keyClaims: Computes contextual representations within a single sequence
Computes weighted sum of Values using scaled dot-product attention softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V
Captures pairwise token dependencies across arbitrary sequence distances

entities.definition: An attention architecture running multiple attention heads in parallel across different linear representation subspaces.
keyClaims: Projects queries, keys, and values into h distinct lower-dimensional subspaces
Computes scaled dot-product attention in parallel for all heads
Concatenates head outputs and projects linearly to final output

entities.definition: Skip connections that add the input of a sub-layer directly to its output prior to normalization.
keyClaims: Computes x + SubLayer(x) across each encoder and decoder sub-layer
Enables uninterrupted gradient propagation through deep Transformer stacks
Mitigates the vanishing gradient problem

entities.definition: A normalization technique computing mean and variance across feature dimensions for each individual token independently.
keyClaims: Normalizes activations across features for each individual sample and token
Stabilizes training dynamics independent of batch size
Applied after residual addition in standard Transformer architectures

entities.definition: A position-wise two-layer fully connected network with non-linear activation applied identically to each token representation.
keyClaims: Consists of two linear transformations with non-linear activation (e.g. ReLU or GeLU)
Operates identically and independently on each sequence position
Expands representation dimension then projects back to model dimension
